title: No direct coverage for devotional by-date route binding
reasoning: The owned route maps devotionals/by-date/ to DevotionalByDateView, but the included devotional API tests exercise only /api/devotionals/ list behavior and import DevotionalListView. There is no included test that resolves or requests devotionals/by-date/, so a URL typo, accidental removal, or wrong view binding for this feature could pass the shown test set.
recommendation: Add a focused route/API test for /api/devotionals/by-date/ or reverse('devotional-on-date') that asserts the route resolves to DevotionalByDateView and returns the expected response for representative query parameters.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests cover the general devotional list endpoint, filtering, ordering, search, and limits, but do not request or resolve the by-date route declared in hub/urls.py.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create a test in hub/tests/test_devotional_list_api.py or a dedicated devotional by-date test module that seeds a Day/Devotional, calls /api/devotionals/by-date/ with the required date/church inputs, and asserts a 200 response with the expected devotional payload.
minimumFixScope: Test-only change covering the route declaration and expected by-date behavior.
